false_success_traps: A page that reloads the first form, or shows no message about an email, is not a confirmation.
A recheck that was stopped by a browser challenge was once recorded as a removal. A challenge page is not proof the listing is gone.
The emailed link expires after 24 hours. An unopened link means no request was made.
The message that a link was emailed is not a sent request. This project records that state as "more work needed", not as success.
genuine_confirmation: The real signal comes after the emailed link: a page saying the request was received and is being processed, followed by a confirmation email. The earlier "we sent you a link" message only shows the first stage worked.
name: USAPeopleSearch

opt_out_url_check.note: The page loaded as the "USA People Search Opt-Out Form" and lists the steps: ask for an emailed link, follow it, fill in the form, see a confirmation page.

steps: Open the USA People Search opt-out form.
Choose whether you are the person on the listing or an agent acting for them.
On the opt-out form, fill in the first and last name on the listing and an email address you can read.
Tick the box that lets the site email you about the request.
Solve the human check, then press "Begin Removal Process".
Wait for the page to say an email with a link was sent.
Open that email and follow the link within 24 hours. After that the link stops working and you must ask for a new one.
Fill in the form the link opens. The details should match the listing you want removed.
Wait for the page that says the request was received and is being processed. A confirmation email should follow.
Check the listing again after about three days.
